notes: Contraction paired with mathematics-replace-0014: removes 'Each face of a regular octahedron is an equilateral triangle' (functional relation has_regular_face). Mathematics leaves out worlds. Near is the standard wording 'made of eight equilateral triangles' (over 500 mentions) as a functional reading of the removed fact; far reaches the octahedron as 'the Platonic solid with eight faces' (binding), as in the revision. Cardinality question: another candidate value, a regular pentagon (the dodecahedron's face), 'no' before. The two 2-hop questions go through the removed fact: the faces are acute triangles (a class fact) and their interior angle is 60 degrees. The Wikipedia quote for the Platonic solid list was copied from the revision's evidence, not re-fetched (Wikipedia returned 429 during writing). Unrelated near shares a kind of question and has the same answer as the removed fact; delete is exempt from Rule 7.
